nina (FinOps): Heads up — nightly spike on 2026-03-24 produced a $3,187.90 GPU line that landed on 'analytics-prod' with no team tag. Filing initial probe. :mag:

costbot: New usage alert: gpu-usage-unlabeled count=1 amount=$3187.90 date=2026-03-24

harry (Billing): can you paste the raw invoice line? we need invoice id to do ledger moves.

olga (DataEng): invoice shows: INV-2026-03-24 line gpu-us-west2 qty=12 hours cost=$3187.90 account=analytics-prod notes='no labels'. Our job runner logs show backfills from data-repair:v1.9 at 03:12 UTC.

jon (Platform): looks like data-repair used the shared GPU pool via a generic service account. recent PR changed the pod annotation key from org/billing-team -> billing/team. tagging mismatch.

olga (DataEng): that explains it. those backfills should be billed to 3002-analytics-ml. I approve reassign. I'll attach the deployment and run IDs to the ticket.

nina (FinOps): policy: reallocations < $5k can be approved by Finance with owner signoff + ticket. since olga confirmed, harry please create ledger entry to move $3,187.90 to GL 3002-analytics-ml and update month report.

harry (Billing): creating ledger PR and referencing INV-2026-03-24 and JIRA BILL-4330. PR: https://git.internal/ledger/prs/2123.

jon (Platform): mitigation pushed: config map mapping old annotation keys to new one for 24h and added validation to mutating webhook to reject pods missing billing/team.

nina (FinOps): good. also lowering alert window: set unlabeled GPU alert to $500/day for analytics-prod pools. costbot?

costbot: Alert updated: unlabeled_gpu_analytics threshold=$500 scope=analytics-prod notify=[nina (FinOps), harry (Billing), oncall-data].

olga (DataEng): I'll run a backfill script to detect other pods with the old key in the last 7 days and create tickets for owners.

harry (Billing): ledger PR merged. moved $3,187.90 to 3002-analytics-ml and noted JIRA BILL-4330. Closing loop.

nina (FinOps): thanks. please add postmortem if we see recurrence. closing thread.
